scheme_name: Birsa Fasal Rahat Yojana (Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana)
description: A financial compensation scheme replacing crop insurance, providing direct monetary assistance to farmers who face major crop losses due to drought, floods, or unseasonal weather.
benefits: Financial relief of ₹3,000 per acre for crop damage between 30% and 50%; ₹4,000 per acre for crop damage exceeding 50% (up to a maximum cap of 5 acres per farmer).
eligibility: Small, marginal, and tenant/sharecropper farmers residing in Jharkhand
Must have cultivated crops during the notified Kharif or Rabi season on registered land
documents: Land Possession Certificate (LPC) or Revenue Receipt
Self-Declaration Form for Sharecroppers/Tenant Farmers (certified by Mukhiya/Patwari)
application_mode: Online via JRFRY Portal (jrfry.jharkhand.gov.in) or CSC Outlets

description: Promotes fruit orchard cultivation (mango, guava, lemon, teak) on fallow or unutilized land under MGNREGA, generating long-term sustainable income for rural households.
benefits: Free supply of high-yielding fruit saplings (100 plants per acre), 100% wage coverage for land preparation/fencing/pitting under MGNREGA, and complete maintenance support for 3 years.
eligibility: Rural households with MGNREGA Job Card owning 0.5 to 1 acre of fallow/barren land
Priority given to SC/ST households, single women, and smallholder farmers
documents: Bank Account Details linked to MGNREGA
application_mode: Offline through Gram Sabha / MGNREGA Block Program Officer (BPO)

description: Provides financial subsidies to small and marginal farmers, SHGs, and FPOs to purchase modern agricultural machinery like tractors, rotavators, power tillers, and harvesters.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy on farm implements and micro-tractors for individual farmers; up to 80% subsidy for setting up Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) by Women SHGs.
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Jharkhand, Women Self-Help Groups (SHGs), and registered FPOs
application_mode: Online via Jharkhand Krishi Portal / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Birsa Munda Irrigation / Well Construction Scheme
description: Provides financial support for digging open irrigation wells (Kua Construction) to ensure round-the-year water availability for small-scale farming and vegetable growing.
benefits: Financial grant up to ₹5,00,000 per well constructed under MGNREGA and state agriculture convergence funds.
eligibility: Small and marginal SC/ST farmers owning arable land with suitable underground water table
application_mode: Offline via Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office (BDO)

description: Encourages adoption of chemical-free organic farming practices through cluster formation, training, bio-input distribution, and free Third-Party PGS Organic Certification.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹20,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs, vermicompost unit construction, and free group organic certification.
eligibility: Farmers or farmer groups/clusters (minimum 20 hectares total) committed to organic practices in Jharkhand
application_mode: Online via Jharkhand State Organic Certification Agency (JSOCA) / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Siddho-Kanho Agriculture and Forestry Co-operative Development Scheme
description: Strengthens rural cooperatives involved in collecting, processing, and marketing minor forest produce (Tendu leaves, Mahua, Lac, Sal seeds) and rainfed crops.
benefits: Financial assistance, working capital soft loans, and processing equipment subsidies up to 75% for tribal co-operatives and SHGs.
eligibility: Primary Agriculture Cooperative Societies (PACS), Forest Cooperatives, and Tribal SHGs in Jharkhand
documents: List of Member Farmers / Forest Collectors
Bank Account Details of the Society
application_mode: Offline through District Cooperative Officer (DCO) / Cooperative Department Portal

description: Promotes high-yielding crossbred cow and buffalo rearing, establishment of mini dairy units (2 to 10 cattle), and setting up automatic milk collection centers.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy for General category and up to 75% subsidy for SC/ST and Women beneficiaries on purchase of milch cattle and construction of cattle sheds.
eligibility: Permanent resident livestock farmers, women SHGs, and rural unemployed youth in Jharkhand
documents: Land Availability Proof for Cattle Shed
application_mode: Offline via District Animal Husbandry Officer (DAHO) or Online via State AH Portal

description: Supports traditional lac growers by providing high-yielding brood lac, pruning equipment, host tree (Ber, Palas, Kusum) care, and processing support.
benefits: Free supply of brood lac seeds, 80% subsidy on lac processing kits, and free technical training provided by ICAR-IINRG Ranchi.
eligibility: Tribal and smallholder lac farmers residing in notified forest/fringe districts of Jharkhand
documents: Forest Right / Land Document for Host Trees
application_mode: Offline via District Forest Office / ICAR-IINRG / Block Extension Office

scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Fisheries Development Scheme (Cage Culture & Ponds)
description: Promotes fish production through cage culture in large reservoirs (e.g., Chandil Dam), renovation of old ponds, and setting up fish hatcheries.
benefits: 50% to 60% subsidy for setting up fish farming cages, purchasing fish seed/feed, and constructing new fish ponds (up to ₹2.5 Lakh per acre).
eligibility: Local fishermen, displaced reservoir families, SHGs, and small farmers in Jharkhand
documents: Fishermen Cooperative Membership Proof / Land LPC
Displaced Family Certificate (for reservoir cage culture)
application_mode: Online via Jharkhand Fisheries Portal / District Fisheries Office

scheme_name: Solar Pump Installation Scheme (PM-KUSUM Component-B Jharkhand)
description: Helps farmers replace diesel pumps with stand-alone solar water pumps for reliable, cost-effective irrigation in un-electrified agricultural fields.
benefits: Up to 80% combined state and central subsidy on standalone solar pumpsets (3 HP to 7.5 HP capacity).
eligibility: Individual farmers, water user associations, and joint liability groups owning land in Jharkhand without electricity access
documents: Declaration of No Existing Electric Connection on Pump Site
application_mode: Online via JREDA Portal (jreda.com) or District Agriculture Office
